title: AI Trader for CFDs
author: Short_Ad7556
selftext:
Hi Guys, I traded CFDs a few weeks ago, and I lost money as 60-70% of retail investors do. CFDs basically can increase wins x5, and increase losses x5. 

I lost because of emotion. I was routinely up money, 300 $ a few trades, 800$ another trade. But instead of cashing in, I wanted more and basically it went back down.

So I'm building an AI assisted app where it follows rules, not emotion. It cuts losses quickly, let's gains run, and closes gains when the tide turns. It also will pick stocks that are breaking out in a direction or based on other factors that mean they are probably going to keep going up or down that day.

$5,000 start . If 2% increase a week, that's $14,000 at end of year. 

This may or may not work. Anyone any experience or insight?
